findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: CHK-002 plan required refining the scaffolded-only warning at line 757 to fire only when no real path is taken, but probeHostRuntime still emits `runtime is scaffolded only: Lattice records invocation metadata and waits for a local receipt; it does not auto-drive the external host.` for codex and gemini when available in PATH, even though runDispatch now has real dispatch paths for both. Line 798 limitations array also still says Real-host execution is scaffolded only in this milestone and line 801 says No external host is auto-driven by Lattice dispatch_run — both factually false for codex/gemini when allowRealHostSubprocess=true. The plan checklist CHK-002 explicitly required this fix.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 449387731: F-001 probeHostRuntime now skips scaffolded-only warning + limitations for codex/gemini (supportsLiveDispatch branch); F-002 dispatch_auto now allows codex/gemini hosts; F-003 isProviderName includes 'gemini'; F-004 isRealProvider includes 'gemini'; F-005 unused worktreeAbs param removed.

findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: background.md (a1) promises lattice dispatch_auto --host=codex invokes a real codex subprocess when CLI is in PATH, and (a2) promises --host=gemini invokes real gemini subprocess — but dispatch_auto still throws at line 3081-3084 for any selectedHost !== claude-code. Additionally line 3008 always passes allowRealHostSubprocess=false for codex/gemini, so even if the guard were bypassed the runDispatch switch at lines 2506/2515 would never fire the real paths. The real codex/gemini dispatch is only reachable via direct programmatic runDispatch calls with allowRealHostSubprocess=true, not via dispatch_auto.
